scope: N08-B01 v1 unit semantics and identity only; not whole N08/N09 or producer acceptance

method.fingerprint: SHA-256 of repository canonicalJson(question), recursively sorted object keys
method.keyLongestMethod: Strict character length comparison of keyed text against each wrong option; used as a signal only, interpreted with actual choice content under §4.3.

finding.requirement: BIZQ-01 §4.3 requires plausible alternatives with comparable specificity and forbids a systematic longest-answer cue.
finding.rationale: 17/18 keyed options are longest. Across the unit the keys repeatedly append operation-level steps and restate scenario invariants, while distractors are shorter partial actions. Combined with the repeated option pattern, the cue can substitute form recognition for comparing the case boundary.
finding.correction: Shorten keyed choices to the discriminating owner/operation boundary; rely on stem facts already given. Do not pad distractors or require equal lengths or a fixed choice count.

nonblockingObservations.finding: The mechanismOrProperty, boundaryOrTradeoff, and transfer Details fields are identical across the 18 items. They do state the common ownership principle; the scenarioApplication and error correction supply per-case facts, so this repetition alone is not a blocker.
Several prompts use awkward capitalization such as “In A …, A …”. Editorial polish is optional.
